# EF (Education First)

> EF is a global education company offering language learning, study abroad programs, corporate training, and cultural exchange experiences across 54+ destinations worldwide.

EF operates regional hubs and global platforms serving learners of all ages, from individual students to corporate clients. The company specializes in English and multilingual education through online courses, in-person instruction, and immersive travel experiences.

## Key Topics

- Language learning
- Study abroad
- English courses
- Corporate training
- Online learning
- Cultural exchange
- Educational travel
- International programs
- EF English Live
- EF Corporate Learning
- EF Academy
- EF SET
- Efekta Method
- Multilingual education
- Educational exchange

## Online Learning Platforms

- [EF English Live](https://englishlive.ef.com/en): 24/7 live English courses with certified teachers for learners worldwide, offering flexible online education.

## Corporate & Professional Training

- [EF Corporate Learning](https://corporatelearning.ef.com/en): Business language training and employee development using the Efekta Method for corporate clients.

## Global Regional Hubs

- [EF Canada](https://www.ef.com/cafr): Language programs, study abroad, and cultural exchange opportunities for Canadian learners.
- [EF Chile](https://www.ef.com/cl): Language learning and study abroad programs for students in Chile and Latin America.
- [EF Venezuela](https://www.ef.com/ve): Language courses and international exchange programs for Venezuelan students.
- [EF Saudi Arabia](https://www.ef.com/sa): English and language learning programs serving the Middle East region.
- [EF Kazakhstan](https://www.ef.com/kz): Language courses with study abroad opportunities in 18 countries worldwide.

## Global Multilingual Sites

- [EF Global Site (Español)](https://www.ef.com/wwes): Spanish-language platform offering language learning and study abroad programs globally.
- [EF Global Site (Français)](https://www.ef.com/wwfr): French-language platform with language programs and study abroad in 54 destinations.
- [EF Global Site (العربية)](https://www.ef.com/wwar): Arabic-language platform for language education and international study programs.
- [EF Global Site (Português)](https://www.ef.com/wwpt): Portuguese-language platform with university-recognized language courses and programs.

## Careers & Opportunities

- [EF Careers](https://careers.ef.com): Job listings and career opportunities across EF offices in Boston, London, Zurich, and North America.
